metadata.description: gon2gon2's agent skills, packaged as plugins.

plugins.name: orca-workflows
plugins.description: Workflows that run coding agents through Orca. rather-than-me sends one brief to frontier models made by other AI labs, collects their independent reviews and compares them with its own view. issue-autopilot sets up a scheduled Orca automation that implements a repo's GitHub issues one at a time from a runbook, each in a fresh worktree ending in a PR. orca-setup audits how you use Orca and applies setup changes one approved item at a time: bundled skills, worktree rules for your agent instructions, hooks that block `git worktree remove` on Orca worktrees and say when a worktree cleanup pass is due, and orca.yaml shared directories. adopt-pet turns your own character art into an Orca pet: a .codex-pet bundle whose animations follow your agents' state, with rows you have no art for filled in, validated against Orca's import rules. review-queue reviews the pull requests waiting on you, one Orca worker per PR, and posts only the draft you approve. Works from Claude Code and Codex. Requires Orca.

plugins.name: dev-practices
plugins.description: Practices for building agent skills and keeping a codebase honest. deterministic-sandwich moves every deterministic step of a skill into a script so the LLM makes exactly one natural-language judgment. comment-diet is a setup wizard that bans code comments in a repo: it installs a comment lint with a baseline that only shrinks, a pull-request check and a repo-local delete-comment skill that moves decisions into tests or records and files issues for excuses.
